name: C1ᵀ = zR0′ᵀ + zK′ᵀ + zGmean
network: ao_nogain recipe (ablation/aug-ops: --wave_aug_ops noise,shift), EMA weights, eval mode

terms.zR0p: z-score of R0 = ArcFace CE of the clip's own machine-ID logit averaged over circular shifts 0, +1%, -1% of the 160,000-sample clip
terms.zKp: 1-NN cosine distance of the pre-head 128-d embedding (mean over the 3 shifted copies of the L2-normalised embedding, re-normalised) to the ID's training-part clips; bank z-stats leave-one-out
terms.zGmean: 1-NN cosine distance of gmean (512-d mean over the 8x20 grid of mobilefacenet.conv2 output, the input to linear7), UNshifted, to the ID's training-part clips; bank z-stats leave-one-out

bank: per machine ID: training clips with valid == False (the replayed 95% the checkpoint trained on); the bank gets the same TTA as the test clips
z_statistics: per ID, mean and population sd over the bank (K and G: each bank clip scored leave-one-out)
shift_op: torch.roll of the wave by round(f*160000) samples; mel recomputed from the rolled wave (ablation/tta/extract_tta.py); shift 0 uses the CPU mel
code: synthesis/single-final/score.py: score_member(tr, te, tr_label, te_label, valid, rule)
